owner_decision: The owner selected this exact full v9 sheet as the sole Companion inner-face baseline. Previously rejected or superseded image rounds cannot be restored, sampled, combined, or used as fallback art.

historical_prompt_record.future_change_rule: A future visual change is an in-context local retouch of one named visible variable on this exact source. It must preserve all locked non-target cells and receive a separate owner decision before resource replacement.

forbidden: physical or owner visual PASS claim

activation_gate: A candidate pack remains inactive until a separate resource activation decision, target integration evidence, and focused physical/visual acceptance are recorded.
